verdict.rationale: Linear's 'Loops' feature lets users describe a recurring job in plain language and choose to run it on a schedule or in response to an event, directly matching trigger-and-action automation to eliminate manual steps; it also supports sharing/favoriting loops for team-wide reuse (linear-docs-11, linear-docs-36, linear-docs-77, linear-docs-46). Webhooks and the GraphQL API further allow building custom event-driven automations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Loops in practice, and detail on the breadth of trigger conditions/actions available beyond the high-level description.
